name: Cleared Product 3
definition: Financial instrument cleared by a central counterparty, with cleared gross notional amount.

TradingVenue.name: Trading Venue
TradingVenue.definition: Exchange or trading venue where product is traded.

CCPProductIdentification.name: CCP Product Identification
CCPProductIdentification.definition: CCP's unique identification for product cleared.

UniversalProductIdentification.name: Universal Product Identification
UniversalProductIdentification.definition: Standard unique identification of product cleared.

Product.name: Product
Product.definition: Choice between the major categories of financial instruments.

OpenInterest.name: Open Interest
OpenInterest.definition: Measure of the current stock of a financial instrument that has been traded on an exchange or cleared via a central counterparty.

TradesCleared.name: Trades Cleared
TradesCleared.definition: Number of trades cleared over the reporting period.

ClearedGrossNotionalAmount.name: Cleared Gross Notional Amount
ClearedGrossNotionalAmount.definition: Gross notional amount that was cleared for that product on the report date.

MarginRatePortfolio.name: Margin Rate Portfolio
MarginRatePortfolio.definition: Margin charged on portfolio containing only a fixed amount of a particular product, enabling users to understand the changing risk associated with that product.
